rss: Microsoft says services fully restored after day-long global outage
title: Big Tech Glitch Affects Kids Apps
story: Many kids couldn't use their favorite apps because of a big glitch. But now, everything is back to normal!
storyBig: A major tech outage disrupted several popular apps used by kids for learning and fun. These services are now fully operational after a day-long effort to resolve the issue.
